title: AI-Powered Medical Prescription OCR System
excerpt: Prototype AI system that digitizes handwritten prescriptions using multi-engine OCR, medical NLP, and 253K+ Indian medicine database.
challenge: Handwritten prescriptions cause medication errors and delays in pharmacy workflows
solution: Multi-engine OCR with Google, Azure & AWS, combined with medical NLP and drug database enrichment
results: 98-99% extraction accuracy, 3-5 second processing, 253K+ medicine database
contentHtml:
⚠️

Demo Product

This is a prototype with synthetic data. Not for production medical use without proper compliance and validation.

Try the Live Demo

Upload a prescription image and watch AI extract medications, dosages & more.

Launch Demo →

What It Does

The system digitizes handwritten doctor prescriptions by combining multiple cloud OCR engines with medical NLP to extract structured data including patient info, medications, dosages, and frequencies.

98%+

Accuracy

3-5s

Processing

253K+

Medicines

3

OCR Engines

How It Works

  1. Upload — Drag & drop a prescription image
  2. Process — Image preprocessing, parallel OCR, best result selection
  3. Extract — Medical NLP extracts medications, dosages, frequencies
  4. Enrich — Match against 253K+ Indian medicine database with RxNorm codes
  5. Review — Editable results with confidence scores for pharmacist verification

Key Features

  • Multi-Engine OCR: Google Document AI + Azure Form Recognizer + AWS Textract running in parallel
  • Medical NLP: AWS Comprehend Medical for entity extraction + Gemini AI for error correction
  • Drug Database: 253K+ Indian medicines with fuzzy matching and RxNorm standardization
  • Smart Routing: Confidence-based auto-approval or pharmacist review queues

Try It Yourself

  1. Visit demo.qbitlog.com
  2. Navigate to the Clinic page
  3. Upload any prescription image (JPG/PNG)
  4. Watch real-time extraction progress
  5. Review and edit extracted data
  6. Send to pharmacy workflow

⚡ Demo Limitations

  • • No authentication (open demo)
  • • All data is synthetic
  • • Not HIPAA/GDPR compliant
  • • Requires internet for cloud APIs

title: Secure Banking App for Regional Credit Union
excerpt: Built a secure, compliant mobile banking application serving 50,000+ members with real-time transactions and biometric authentication.
challenge: Modernize legacy banking system with mobile-first approach while maintaining strict security compliance
solution: Developed cross-platform mobile app with end-to-end encryption, biometric authentication, and real-time transaction processing
results: Increase in mobile transactions, high uptime, strong security posture
contentHtml:
When a regional credit union approached us to modernize their banking experience, they had a legacy system that was difficult to maintain and didn't meet modern user expectations. Their members needed a secure, intuitive mobile banking solution comparable to the best-in-class apps.

The Challenge

Key challenges included:

  • Legacy Integration: Integrate with existing core banking systems without disruption
  • Security & Compliance: Meet PCI DSS and banking security requirements
  • Accessible UX: Design for a wide range of ages and abilities
  • Real-time Updates: Provide instant balances and transaction confirmations

Our Solution

We built a cross-platform mobile app using React Native with a security-first architecture:

  • Biometric Authentication: Native Face/Touch ID for secure login
  • Encrypted Transport: TLS 1.2+ for all traffic and data minimization
  • Proactive Alerts: Real-time transaction and security notifications
  • Defense in Depth: MFA, device attestation, and fraud monitoring

Technical Implementation

The backend used Node.js and PostgreSQL with a microservices approach:

  • Event-driven services for scale and resilience
  • Redis caching for session and rate limits
  • AWS managed services for observability and security
  • PCI-compliant payment gateway integration for card operations

Impact

The credit union saw higher mobile engagement, strong reliability, and positive user feedback while maintaining strict security.

title: High-Traffic E-commerce Platform Migration
excerpt: Migrated legacy e-commerce system to modern cloud architecture, ready for peak-season traffic spikes.
challenge: Legacy system struggled during peak events, causing slow pages and instability
solution: Cloud-native migration with microservices, auto-scaling, and modern frontend
results: Improved conversion rates, lower page load times, stable peak performance
contentHtml:
A leading fashion retailer faced outages and slow pages during sales events. We modernized the stack to improve resilience and performance.

The Problem

  • Traffic Spikes: Unpredictable bursts overwhelmed the monolith
  • Performance: Long TTFB and blocking rendering
  • Data Layer: Single-node database created a bottleneck

Our Approach

  • Microservices: Independent services with clear contracts
  • Cloud-Native: Auto-scaling and managed services
  • Modern Frontend: Next.js with SSR/ISR for fast pages
  • Caching: Redis and CDN for low latency

Impact

The platform now sustains peak traffic with faster pages and improved conversion.

title: Telemedicine Platform for Rural Healthcare
excerpt: HIPAA-aligned telemedicine platform connecting rural patients with specialists.
challenge: Limited specialist access and long travel times for rural patients
solution: Secure video consults, integrated scheduling, and provider-to-provider data sharing
results: Reduced travel, faster access to care, high patient satisfaction
contentHtml:
Rural patients often travel hours for specialist care. We built a telemedicine platform to bridge that gap securely.

Challenges

  • Access: Long travel and limited local specialists
  • Privacy: Protected health information requirements
  • Device Diversity: Varying connectivity and devices

Solution

  • Secure Video: WebRTC with encrypted transport
  • Scheduling: Integrated calendars and reminders
  • Records: Provider-to-provider data exchange

Impact

Patients access specialists sooner with less travel; providers coordinate care more efficiently.

solution: Forecasting, route optimization, and predictive alerts

Operational metrics improved across cost, speed, and on-time delivery.
